name: Одно лицо в разных местах
about: Фото человека во вход «лица» двух новых сцен: Ref2VA держит лицо, места разные.

data.title: Кафе
data.text:
Realistic live-action cinematic look, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, film grain.

Scene: a cozy café at night, warm pendant lights; the woman from <Picture 1> sits at the window with a cup of coffee.

Camera: medium close-up, static camera, her face clearly visible.

Timeline:
[0s-3s] She lifts the cup and takes a sip.
[3s-5s] She looks out at the rain and smiles.

Audio: rain on the glass, quiet café murmur.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

data.title: Улица
data.text:
Realistic live-action cinematic look, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, film grain.

Scene: a wet city street at night, neon reflections; the woman from <Picture 1> walks under a clear umbrella.

Camera: medium shot, the camera tracks backward in front of her, her face clearly visible.

Timeline:
[0s-3s] She walks toward the camera.
[3s-5s] She stops and looks up at the rain.

Audio: rain on the umbrella, distant traffic.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

Лицо по фото (Ref2VA).

Загрузите фото в узел «Лицо»: анфас, лицо крупно, нейтральный фон. Фото идёт во вход «лица» обеих сцен — их снимет модель Ref2VA, и лицо будет одно в разных местах. В промте человек назван «from <Picture 1>».
